notes: Every source and target ID is partitioned exactly once.

Both articles before the possessives are unrepresented under rules 54 and 20: ἐμόν is a possessive adjective naming its possessor, and ὑμῶν is a free genitive pronoun, so in each case another source word occupies the determiner slot.

s011/s012: the materially different alternative is rule 49 read strictly — article unrepresented and them that are such whole on the demonstrative. The antecedent-pronoun split is taken because rule 20's own text names a supplied antecedent pronoun as something a displaced article still takes, and rule 92 places the relativizer and copula on the word predicated of.
